name: mind-atlas
description: An agent skill that turns a project, system or topic into a multi-level, interactive HTML mind map: decide what the map is for (learning, project tracking or a decision), choose a level, research branches with read-only sub-agents, build a single-file page, and collect feedback right on the map, with a console and a staleness check for maps you keep open for days. English and Chinese. For Claude Code and Codex.
